speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The shoe goes on. Hewlands will not take a bare foot.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It will go on. I do not promise it will thank me.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Six. A sickle needs a back. You said you would be out.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Bread in the cloth. Small beer was set last night, and it is by the door.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Dinner is an hour when Bartholomew calls it, not when you are tired of straw.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six till four. I have it.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: And no sermon in a field. He has wheat.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: The wide thumb-stall is in your pocket. Richard put it there last night, and I am not hunting it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The wide one is in the pocket. The heel is in. Nobody is weeping.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Wash at your father's when you are back, not in Bartholomew's ditch.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I'll wash at home. The bundle stays on the shelf.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Two leaves was yesterday. Today is a back.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: Bartholomew will use the back and not the sentence. That is the use of you.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have bound there before. The hands remember the twist.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: If the heel weeps on the lane I am telling the twins at breakfast, and you will hear it at supper.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Home before half past six. Quiney and Sturley are the table, and the ditch is not a perfume.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have the hour, and I have the table.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: The row is not yours today. The children kept it, and a field is enough for one back.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not going up the row. Thursday is theirs.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Then go as one pair of hands. The house has had enough of a string of nine.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: The bread is in the cloth. Go while the lane is still grey.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Six till four. The hour for dinner is his to call.

speaker: john_shakespeare
text: And no price of barley in a field. If you have a price, the table is tonight, and Sturley will ask it.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I have no price to take into a field. I am taking a back.

speaker: joan_shakespeare
text: Then take it. The latch is on the pin, and the lane is dry.

speaker: anne_shakespeare
text: Go on. The shoe has done its part.
